title: NVIDIA Cosmos Opens New Tools to Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models
hook_text: Nvidia just dropped new open world models.
script:
Nvidia expanded the Cosmos platform with new training tools.
The platform includes new simulation checkpoints and Cosmos Data Factory blueprints.
These tools help developers rapidly build world models for physical AI systems.
World models help physical AI systems understand and simulate the real world.
Nvidia Cosmos ranks top five on six different open models leaderboards.
The platform gives world model builders frontier open models.
Will you use these tools for your next simulation?
